verdict.rationale: Letta documents mechanisms that revise memory over time. Dreaming background subagents "consolidate useful lessons, and update memory" on configurable triggers, `/remember` lets the agent decide where a lesson belongs and commit it to MemFS, and `/doctor` audits duplication and drift. Memory is text/file-based, so developers can inspect and edit it directly. However, nothing explicitly describes detecting contradictions or superseding or merging conflicting facts, so the story is only inferred from general consolidation features. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of contradiction detection and supersede/merge semantics, independent or hands-on evidence that stale facts are actually replaced.
